name: Clearing Method 1 Code
definition: Specifies whether the value is net (inclusive of tax) or gross.

GRNE.name: Gross Negotiation
GRNE.definition: Each trade is settled by a single entry to the account of the beneficiary.

NEMA.name: Net Match
NEMA.definition: In a foreign exchange transaction, the third party as a central clearing counterparty will settle the transaction for both sides respectively.

NENE.name: Net Negotiation
NENE.definition: Settlement done by netting amounts (for trades in the same currency and for the same value date).
